title: About the Center
text:
Our Core Agendas


01. Infrastructure


Building the Foundation
Research in technology-education is only as good as its measurement. CATER focuses on the development of validated psychometric scales and open-source methodological tools.




02. Translation


From Data to Action
We believe that research is incomplete until it is accessible. Our translation wing develops teacher-ready toolkits and provides evidence-based briefings for policy stakeholders.




03. Accelerator


The CATER Network
Inspired by large-scale collaborative models, our Accelerator supports rapid, multi-site data collection. By pooling resources and expertise, our members can execute high-powered studies.
